name: Jaime Alonso
headline: I build fullstack applications and coordinate AI agent teams, from software architecture and databases to UI/UX and production monitoring.

points: Develop web applications and backend services for Welloop's youth sports platform using Next.js, React, Node.js and TypeScript.
Build an AI-powered chat app with custom permission access, alongside payments, integrations, notifications and a team management surface with events and communications.
Build and coordinate AI agent teams, automate development workflows, and use agent evaluations to test and refine their performance.
Built and launched MIRTO's mobile app and developed internal tools for analytics, notifications and factory operations.
Built a Shopify integration to synchronise product listings across international stores.

education.title: Higher Technician in Cross-Platform Software Development
